text: Retail sales, industrial output, and fixed asset investments undershot expectations in April. Property investment contraction deepened while export growth accelerated. Producer prices rose faster than consumer prices. Domestic consumption stimulus showed limited expansion while trade coordination mechanisms between the U.S. and China remained active.

meta.note: Export strength and domestic weakness operate simultaneously without convergent settlement.

text: Lululemon publicly opposed founder Chip Wilson's board nominees after settlement talks collapsed. Competing director slates were presented ahead of the annual meeting. The company defended existing leadership and incoming CEO Heidi O'Neill while citing governance, expertise, and competitor-alignment concerns regarding Wilson-backed nominees.

meta.note: Control contest spans governance, creative direction, and operational authority simultaneously.
